description: Responsible of the selling of hydraulic & pneumatic equipment in Mexico and USA to clients in the Energy, Chemical & Mining industries
Meeting quotas of $1.4M USD annually by renewing contracts and opening new accounts within assigned territory
Pioneered sales outreach to potential US clients and developed sales plan to increase client base outside of Mexico
Scheduling 2-3 in-person client meetings with potential US customers on a quarterly basis
Managing accounts in the energy industry like PEMEX and in the metallurgical & chemical industry like MET-MEX Peñoles
Developing business plans to identify key opportunities and deliver added value to up-sell products and services to key accounts
Booking customer follow-up calls or in-person meetings with Top 50 accounts bi-monthly to maintain customer retention
Generating sales reports and forecasts for management review
Preparing quotations that meet customers specific needs and support collections efforts.
Obtained new accounts by selling financial products and services to consumers and businesses
Consistently achieved sales quota by making 50-60 outbound cold calls per day to potential prospects
Maintained relationships to offer the best customer service and provide a personalized financial advice.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a robust background in business development with a focus on international markets, particularly Mexico and the USA. With experience in both multinational corporations and small businesses, they have demonstrated an ability to acquire new accounts while maintaining relationships at both customer service levels. Their bilingual capabilities (English and Spanish) are evident throughout their professional journey, making them a suitable candidate for roles requiring cross-cultural communication and sales strategies targeting diverse markets.
